mainEntity.name: What is token launch PR and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Token launch PR is the coordinated media and influencer campaign that runs around a TGE or token listing: embargo management, tier-1 journalist outreach, exchange listing comms and a phased KOL programme. It is for any project doing a public token event where exchange BD teams, institutional investors and retail communities all need to see consistent, credible coverage on the same day.

mainEntity.name: How much does token launch PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator runs a TGE campaign for $5K–$12K/month on retainer, or as a focused $15K–$40K launch sprint covering four to eight weeks of embargo prep and the launch window itself. Full agencies typically charge $15K–$45K/month because the retainer funds a multi-person account team. KOL budgets sit on top: nano KOLs $200–$1.5K per placement, micro $500–$5K, mid-tier $10K–$30K.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets and deliverables are included in token launch PR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto targets: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, The Defiant. Mainstream where the angle supports it: Forbes, Benzinga, Yahoo Finance. Regional APAC: BloomingBit and TokenPost (Korea), CoinPost and CryptoTimes JP (Japan), ChainCatcher and Jinse (China), Inc42 (India). Deliverables include a narrative brief, individual editor pitches under embargo, a KOL briefing deck with talking points, exchange listing comms, and a post-launch AI-citation report. Coverage depends on a genuine news hook.

mainEntity.name: What is the timeline and process for a token launch PR campaign?

acceptedAnswer.text: The highest-leverage window is six to twelve weeks before your TGE date. Weeks one and two go to narrative development and journalist mapping. Weeks three to six run individual embargo briefings with editors. Launch week sees simultaneous embargo lift, KOL wave one and exchange listing confirmation. Post-launch, wave-two KOLs and feature pitches sustain momentum.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with token launch PR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form with your TGE date, target markets and budget range. You will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your current press footprint and a recommended approach. Or book a 30-minute call directly and we will map the campaign live. No intro deck, no account-team onboarding call.
